# Florence 1347 – Medicine & hygiene

K = knowledge level · use = none/wrong/partial/correct · make = producibility with local means · accept = acceptance.

- **Contagion by invisible living agents (germ theory)** [`contagion_theory`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/contagion_theory.md) — K1, use partial, make medium, accept low. Plague is corrupted, poisonous air from conjunctions and rot. Physicians add that the sick 'infect' others by breath and belongings. Varro's tiny animals are in a rare, unread manuscript. Local: Arte dei Medici e Speziali; physicians trained at Bologna. Elsewhere: Perugia, Gentile da Foligno (poisonous vapour reaching heart and lungs); Granada and Almería, Ibn al-Khatib and Ibn Khatima (their contagion tracts follow in 1349 and after).
- **Abandoning bloodletting, purging and mercury (end of humoral medicine)** [`bloodletting_harm`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/bloodletting_harm.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Bleeding, purging and cupping are standard, also as plague prevention; the plague consilia of 1348 prescribe them. Patients expect it and barbers live from it. Local: Arte dei Medici e Speziali; barbers who perform bloodletting.
- **Counting and mapping cases to find causes (epidemiology)** [`epidemiology_mapping`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/epidemiology_mapping.md) — K1, use none, make easy, accept medium. No death registers exist. Giovanni Villani reports baptisms counted with beans at the Baptistery, and counts of mouths, schools and hospital beds. Parishes and gravediggers could supply tallies. Local: Giovanni Villani; Baptistery of San Giovanni (bean count of baptisms); parish priests and gravediggers (beccamorti).
- **Hand washing with soap** [`hand_hygiene`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/hand_hygiene.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Hands are washed before meals for manners. Soap and basins exist. Washing between patients has no rationale in a medicine of bad air and humours. Local: Arte dei Medici e Speziali; Santa Maria Nuova.
- **Boiling drinking water and protecting wells** [`boiled_water`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/boiled_water.md) — K2, use none, make easy, accept medium. Avicenna advises boiling suspect water. Wells and the Arno supply the city. Talk of something unseen in wells can feed poisoning rumours; Jews are murdered on that charge in 1348–49. Elsewhere: China, habitual tea drinking.
- **Slow sand filtration and chlorination of town water** [`water_filtration_chlorination`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/water_filtration_chlorination.md) — K1, use none, make medium, accept medium. Masons could build a sand filter like the Venetian cisterns. Chlorination is out of reach; no one can make the chemical. Elsewhere: Venice, rainwater cisterns that filter through a bed of sand.
- **Latrines and sewers (keeping excrement out of water, food and soil)** [`sanitation_sewerage`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/sanitation_sewerage.md) — K3, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Statutes forbid dumping filth in streets. Cesspits leak into wells; dyers, tanners and butchers foul the Arno. In early 1348 the commune has the city cleaned against the stench. Local: cesspit emptiers; Arno; commune's street and market officials.
- **Food hygiene (cooking, flies, carriers)** [`food_hygiene`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/food_hygiene.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Officials and the butchers' guild inspect meat and fish by smell and look. Stinking meat counts as a source of corrupt air, so rules tighten in 1348. Local: Mercato Vecchio; butchers' guild (Arte dei Beccai). Elsewhere: Pistoia, ordinances of May 1348 regulate butchers.
- **Quarantine and isolation of the sick** [`quarantine`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/quarantine.md) — K2, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Lepers are segregated; a waiting period for arrivals exists nowhere yet. In 1348 Florence refuses entry to the sick. Closing gates to goods means hunger after the famine; merchants resist. Local: leper hospital of San Jacopo a Sant'Eusebio outside the walls; city gates and their gabelle officials; Signoria (priors of the guilds). Elsewhere: Pistoia, May 1348 ban on people and cloth from Pisa and Lucca; Milan, Visconti restrictions in 1348; Islamic lands, tradition against entering or leaving a plague land.
- **Hospital hygiene and trained nursing** [`nursing_hospital_hygiene`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nursing_hospital_hygiene.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Villani counts thirty hospitals, over a thousand beds. Santa Maria Nuova nurses with lay sisters, food and linen; beds are shared. The Misericordia carries the sick and buries the dead. Local: Ospedale di Santa Maria Nuova (founded 1288); Compagnia della Misericordia; Ospedale di San Gallo (foundlings); Ospedale di San Paolo. Elsewhere: Cairo, Mansuri hospital with wards by disease; Siena, Santa Maria della Scala.
- **Cholera and typhoid spread through drinking water** [`cholera_waterborne`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/cholera_waterborne.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Asiatic cholera does not exist here. Summer fluxes are common, worst after the famine, and blamed on bad food, fruit and air.
- **Oral rehydration (water, salt and sugar)** [`oral_rehydration`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/oral_rehydration.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Salt is taxed and sugar is an apothecary's luxury; honey is the cheap substitute. Physicians restrict drink in fluxes.
- **Plague carried by rats and fleas (and by coughing)** [`plague_vectors`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/plague_vectors.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Rats and fleas are unremarkable. Clothes and bedding of the dead are suspected, rightly. Cheap and possible: flee early, shun coughing patients, boil or burn bedding, keep rats from grain. Local: grain stores at Orsanmichele; second-hand clothes dealers (rigattieri); wool and cloth warehouses.
- **Typhus carried by body lice (delousing)** [`typhus_lice`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/typhus_lice.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Lice are universal and thought to breed from sweat and humours. Famine fevers of 1347 are not told apart. Boiling or baking clothes is possible wherever there is fuel.
- **Malaria carried by mosquitoes (drainage, nets)** [`malaria_mosquito`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/malaria_mosquito.md) — K1, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Marsh fevers (tertian, quartan) are blamed on bad air. Avoiding marshes in summer works for the wrong reason. Drainage is costly; fine cloth nets are cheap. Local: Maremma; Pisan plain; Val di Chiana; Padule di Fucecchio.
- **Cinchona bark (quinine) against malaria** [`quinine`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/quinine.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept high. Cinchona grows in the Andes, on a continent nobody here knows exists. Elsewhere: Andean forests, source of cinchona bark.
- **Consumption (tuberculosis) is contagious** [`tuberculosis_control`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/tuberculosis_control.md) — K2, use none, make easy, accept low. Avicenna's Canon, the university textbook, lists phthisis as catching, but physicians treat it as a constitution. Families nurse the sick at home.
- **Parasitic worms (hookworm, roundworm, tapeworm, guinea worm)** [`parasitic_worms`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/parasitic_worms.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Worms are seen and treated with wormseed and bitter herbs. They are thought to breed from rotting humours; eggs, soil and undercooked pork are not suspected. Local: apothecaries (wormseed).
- **Fresh food prevents scurvy (citrus, vitamin C)** [`scurvy_citrus`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/scurvy_citrus.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Galleys coast from port to port, so sea scurvy is rare; it appears in sieges and famine. Lemons, citrons and bitter oranges come from Sicily, Amalfi and Liguria.
- **Deficiency diseases (beriberi, rickets, pellagra, goitre, night blindness)** [`vitamins_deficiency`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/vitamins_deficiency.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Disease from a missing food is an alien idea. Goitre in Alpine and Apennine valleys is blamed on the water. Liver for night blindness is in the medical authorities.
- **Variolation (inoculation with smallpox matter)** [`variolation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/variolation.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Smallpox is familiar and described by Rhazes. Deliberate infection is unknown anywhere in writing and would look like poisoning, most of all in a plague year.
- **Smallpox vaccination with cowpox** [`smallpox_vaccination`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/smallpox_vaccination.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept low. Smallpox is endemic, mostly a children's disease. Cowpox must be found on cattle in the contado; finding it is a quest. It does nothing against plague.

- **Wound care (stop bleeding, clean, tie vessels, leave dirty wounds open)** [`wound_care`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/wound_care.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Surgeons split over pus: Theodoric of Lucca taught clean healing with wine dressings, most still provoke 'laudable pus'. Plague buboes are cut or cauterised. Bleeding is stopped mainly by cautery. Local: surgeons of the Arte dei Medici e Speziali; surgeons at Santa Maria Nuova. Elsewhere: Bologna, surgical tradition of Theodoric and William of Saliceto; Avignon, Guy de Chauliac.
- **Antiseptics (strong spirit, chlorinated lime, carbolic acid, iodine)** [`antiseptics`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/antiseptics.md) — K2, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Wine and vinegar go on wounds without a theory. Vinegar is the plague year's all-purpose wash for hands, face, coins and rooms. Strong spirit can be made; chlorinated lime cannot. Local: apothecaries; monastery stills.
- **Sterilising instruments and dressings by heat** [`heat_sterilisation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/heat_sterilisation.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Boiling instruments and linen is within any hospital's means. It needs fuel and a new routine; fire is already trusted to purify air.
- **Safe childbirth (clean hands, patience, cord care, forceps)** [`childbirth_care`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/childbirth_care.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept low. Midwives and female relatives attend births at home; physicians stay out. Turning the child is in the Arabic authors. No forceps. Local: midwives; Ospedale di San Gallo and Santa Maria della Scala (foundlings).
- **First aid and resuscitation** [`first_aid_resuscitation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/first_aid_resuscitation.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. No method exists for reviving the apparently dead. The drowned are hung head down or rolled. A revival may be called a miracle or sorcery.
- **Ether anaesthesia** [`ether_anaesthesia`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/ether_anaesthesia.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept medium. Aqua vitae is at hand, but oil of vitriol is a rare, weak alchemist's distillate. Surgeons know the unreliable opium and mandrake sleeping sponge. Local: apothecaries; alchemists.
- **Pain relief with opium and willow bark (laudanum, morphine, aspirin)** [`opium_analgesia`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/opium_analgesia.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Opium is sold mostly inside theriac, the leading plague remedy, at unknown strength; mandrake and henbane too. Willow bark is unused for fever. Dosing is guesswork. Local: apothecaries (speziali); theriac from Venice, Genoa and Montpellier.
- **Blood groups and transfusion** [`blood_groups_transfusion`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/blood_groups_transfusion.md) — K0, use none, make very-hard, accept low. Blood is thought to be made in the liver and consumed. No hollow needles, no way to test compatibility; an attempt will probably kill.
- **Human anatomy from dissection** [`anatomy_dissection`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/anatomy_dissection.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Bologna teaches from Mondino's Anathomia (1316), which mostly confirms Galen. Florence has no anatomy teaching; legal post-mortems, as at Bologna in 1302, are rare but known. Local: physicians of the Arte dei Medici e Speziali; Santa Maria Nuova. Elsewhere: Bologna and Padua, anatomy teaching on executed criminals; Paris, Guido da Vigevano's illustrated Anathomia (1345).
- **Circulation of the blood** [`blood_circulation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/blood_circulation.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept low. Galen: blood ebbs and flows, passes through pores in the heart wall. The arm-ligature demonstration of vein valves needs no equipment. Ibn al-Nafis is unknown here. Elsewhere: Cairo and Damascus, Ibn al-Nafis's account of the passage through the lungs (c. 1242).
- **Physical diagnosis (percussion, stethoscope, thermometer, pulse count)** [`clinical_thermometer_stethoscope`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/clinical_thermometer_stethoscope.md) — K1, use none, make hard, accept medium. Physicians judge pulse by touch and inspect urine in a flask; fever is felt by hand. No small timekeeper exists; a sandglass or counted prayers must serve. Local: glassmakers; physicians' uroscopy.
- **Tooth decay and dental care** [`dental_care`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/dental_care.md) — K1, use wrong, make easy, accept medium. Toothache is blamed on a tooth worm, treated with henbane smoke; barbers and travelling tooth-drawers extract. Sugar is a luxury, so decay is moderate.
